scope: Adversarial source and data review; no live account access, no model fitting or financial trial

rating_semantics.cause: The ordinal gate measures evidence readiness; actual current account return is unavailable.

why_counts_are_zero.explanation: The producer received an empty prospective source list. Eight reconstructed feature vectors are kept in archive_audit because original receipt times and causal label receipts were not recorded; they are not admitted as calibration rows.

actual_causal_contract.selection: FIRST_CAUSAL_FRAME_AT_OR_AFTER_LOCAL_GRID in America/New_York, declared before using the measurement
receipt_and_label_requirements: Original frame must predate build availability
Features are recomputed from the observed input snapshot
Fixed-horizon label uses an observed as-of quote and a maturity receipt
Labels must be known strictly before model availability; model availability must predate comparison
Receipt collection and candidate fitting are separate stages

historical_market_download.allowed_interpretation: A new retrospective diagnostic/research input with recorded download time; not original decision-time availability or proof of net account performance.

capture_controls_seen: Quant capture is scheduled independently of research and numerical calibration when cfg.quant.enabled
The observation journal records accepted and rejected signals with bounds and a linked chain
The streaming causal panel admits causal universe rotations while preserving fixed signal parameters

single_material_finding.mechanism: Configuration invariance was checked separately per page by fromObservationExport, so partitioning the same frames could erase the configuration-change rejection. The common request configuration also was not bound to the normalized source configuration.
single_material_finding.impact_reason: No empirical account source is available; this is an evidence-admission defect, not a measured PnL loss.
single_material_finding.remediation: Validate the original configuration across the entire source prefix and bind common_request.config to source normalization with the deterministic equity/ETF share projection already required by funded_comparison. No selective symbol removal, extra risk change or universe-epoch replay is admitted.
single_material_finding.implementation_owner: root/nivel4_data_adversary, subsequently authorized by parent; two files only

proposed_refutation_tests: Same fixed-configuration frames produce identical binding regardless of page partition
Source configuration changes fail both within a page and across pages
Changed comparison risk, slippage, source-supported universe or protection configuration fails binding
Mixed equity/ETF/crypto source permits exactly the funded equity/ETF projection; dropping a supported equity/ETF fails
Existing clock, source-hash, account, missing-resource and synthetic-evidence tests remain effective
non_goals: No gate threshold or score rewrite
No synthetic source relabeled as observed financial evidence
No new forecasting model, parameter search, order or deployment
